capabilities: Search the vault by keyword and meaning as you type
List notes related to the active note, section or selection
Answer questions with ranked passages from the vault
Collect notes and sections into a context basket for AI chats
extras: Desktop only; phones and tablets are not supported. The engine downloads models from Hugging Face (~330 MB, plus ~1.7 GB for Deep search) after the user confirms. An optional read-only local HTTP API is off by default.
problem: Keyword search misses notes that cover the same idea in different words, and nothing shows which notes are related by content rather than by links.

relations.evidence: with the Text Extractor plugin installed, Trova also searches the text in your image attachments

summary: Local semantic search plugin that finds notes by meaning, shows related notes, answers questions and finds near-duplicate notes.
